mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member ( member_id, member_password, nickname, member_name, member_phone, member_email, profile_image ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{memberPassword}, #{nickname}, #{memberName}, #{memberPhone}, #{memberEmail}, #{profileImage} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE nickname = #{nickname}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE member_email = #{memberEmail}

SELECT member_id AS memberId, member_password AS memberPassword, nickname, member_name AS memberName, member_phone AS memberPhone, member_email AS memberEmail, profile_image AS profileImage, member_status AS memberStatus, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, deleted_at AS deletedAt FROM member WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET nickname = #{nickname}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
UPDATE member SET member_phone = #{memberPhone}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
UPDATE member SET member_email = #{memberEmail}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
UPDATE member SET profile_image = #{profileImage}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
UPDATE member SET member_status = 'DELETED', deleted_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
UPDATE member SET member_status = 'ACTIVE', last_login_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
UPDATE member SET member_status = 'ACTIVE', deleted_at = NULL, last_login_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
